correctness.rationale: For all integers r>=2 and n>=r-1, the four token edge classes have complete exact counts. The mixed-pure cut crosses precisely AB and BD. Fractionally packing explicitly listed AAA/BB-adjacent triangles with weights gamma, alpha, beta, every edge has load at most 1, AA and BB load exactly 1, and the total weight is |AA|+|BB|. Every triangle has an uncut edge, giving the sharp upper bound for any cut. Strict AB slack forces uniqueness for n>=r, and parity lifts produce at least r+1 optimum cuts at n=r-1 and strict better cuts for n<=r-2. The exceptional (r,n)=(2,1) weighting is treated separately. The standalone finite exact checker validates relevant cases without being used for infinity.

value.rationale: The natural maximum-cut invariant in unweighted two-token configuration graphs is determined for an infinite two-parameter family of nonbipartite graphs at a sharp threshold. A nontrivial uniform fractional triangle packing makes the upper bound exact and its positive slack proves a sharp uniqueness transition, while parity lifting identifies a distinct boundary regime. This structural classification cannot be reduced to a numerical example or a routine restatement of the later general bounds.
